About this item

  • FAT32 pre-formatted for broad compatibility: These drives work with Windows (XP through 11), macOS, Linux, Chrome OS, Smart TVs, Car Stereos, and USB-enabled printers without requiring drivers or software installation.   • 31 labels included – pre-printed and blank: Each pack contains 19 pre-printed color-coded labels and 12 blank white labels for organizing drives by project, department, person, or event category. Labels attach directly to each drive for quick identification during multi-user distributions.

Product description

CLARITY ON CAPACITY

  • Digital storage measurement differs between manufacturers (decimal: 1GB = 1,000MB) and computers (binary: 1GiB = 1,024MiB), plus space is needed for the file system.
  • This is an industry-standard practice.
  • For 16GB drive: approximate Usable Space ~14.4 - 14.9 Gigabytes (GiB)*

  • Is USB 2.0 fast enough for everyday use?

    For documents, photos, music, and standard file transfers, USB 2.0 at 15MB/s read speed handles everyday tasks reliably. For large video files, consider our USB 3.0 version.

  • Why is the usable storage less than 16GB?

    The key is the different definitions of a GB from a Operating System and a Disk Drive Manufacturer.

    1. Operating Systems define a GB as 2^30 (1,073,741,824 bytes)

    2. Disk Drive Manufacturers define a GB as 10^9 (one billion bytes).

  • Are these drives compatible with Mac and Windows?

    Yes. Pre-formatted in FAT32 for instant plug-and-play use on Windows (XP–11), macOS, Linux, Chrome OS, Smart TVs, and Car Stereos. No drivers or software needed.

    Registered Business accounts automatically receive tiered discounts on qualifying quantity purchases.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers find these flash drives to be of high quality and appreciate their storage capacity, with 16GB being sufficient for most data needs. The drives are easy to use, plug and play, and offer good value for money. Additionally, customers find the drives slow, with average write speeds around 380KB/s.
